enabled.help: The door holding the owner's prompt first. false takes it out.

warnAt.help: The score where the gate starts writing a warn line to the log.

ceiling.help: The score where the gate names the band rewrite in its log line.

words.help: The words an answer holds outside its code and tables.

find.help: The model a helper runs on that finds, lists, reads and reports.

change.help: The model a helper runs on that makes a scoped change with its test, or reviews against a list.

decide.help: The model a helper runs on that takes a design, an unknown cause, or a verdict the owner reads.

handoverAt.help: The context past which the next pull after the ticket in hand hands the handover, the clear and the read of the handover. 0 switches it off.

enabled.help: The tooth. false ends every turn where the agent asks to end it.

mostInARow.help: The turns the tooth carries one after another before it lets go.

hold.help: What the session does when it reaches the end of a turn.

wanted.help: What the owner wants said at the end of this turn.

hook.help: The hook: start the server behind the bridgehead, and click again to kill it. Shift and click starts it under the debugger, paused at the return of decide.

level.help: The level this box writes at. info writes every line a door says, and debug writes what the hooks see too.

open.help: Open the window, on its log tab, in a terminal beside the editor.
keys: w s move up and down the log
enter open the details, and enter again closes them
pgup pgdown step a whole window
home the first line, end the newest, and it follows

functionLines.help: The lines a function holds at most. The write door refuses a write that grows past it.

fileLines.help: The lines a file holds at most. The write door refuses a write that grows past it.

runs.help: The check's runs the stamp keeps at one commit. A retro reads each part's median over them.

words.help: The words a file, a folder and a branch name each hold at most.

most.help: The span the wait tool holds at most before it returns with no signal.

quiet.help: The span a file stands unchanged before the wait reads it as quiet.

work.comment: Level one. The knobs the work verbs read over a group and its tickets, and the work group's buttons the sidebar draws.

staleAfter.help: The age of a held group's tip that puts it under yours.

failsBeforePerson.help: The times a step fails back before the pull puts a person step in, asking the reason.

refusalsBeforeFail.help: The times one hand-back meets refused before the pull fails the leaf back with the findings.

stepsBeforeSplit.help: The person steps a ticket carries before the pull refuses another and asks for a split.

personSigns.help: The stronger door on a person's hand. Switched on, a person's hand-back on a tracked ticket meets a signed tip.

retroReaders.help: The hands a retro's collect spawns, each taking the next chapter until none stands.

retroCap.help: The tickets a retro's improve step mints, so the list holds what gets done.

blockScore.help: The score a ticket takes for each one waiting under it, down the whole chain.

dayScore.help: The score a ticket takes for each day it stands.

failScore.help: The score a ticket takes for each hand-back that comes back refused.

editor.help: Open the work tab, which draws every ticket and takes a cell edit. The count beside it is the rows the work tab draws as it opens.

pull.help: Take the ticket waiting on you first, and open it.

new.help: Open a new ticket under the name the press asks for, with a process to pick.

restated.comment: The runs the restated rules refuse, where one place says again what another holds.

pointer.help: The run a heading shares with the heading its pointer names before the rule draws.

rule.help: The run two rule lines of two guidance notes share before the rule draws.

engine.comment: Level one. The buttons that make a vehicle and a stub, and where the session takes its work from.

vehicle.help: Make a vehicle: a copy of this tree that works on itself, in the folder the press asks for.

stub.help: Make a stub: a bare project this vehicle drives, in the folder the press asks for.

binding.help: Where the session takes its work from. The chapter The engine controls, under spec/design_output/config.md, says what each value means.
